archetype: Industrial & Professional blended with Swiss Utility
emotional_tone: Confident, business-grade, reliable — Mahabir Electricals maroon and white identity.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Optical clarity over geometry. Dense for data, generous for layout margins.

tables.style: Flat grid, horizontal borders only (border-b border-[#E7E5E4]), sticky header. High density.
tables.inline_editing: Hover state reveals subtle 1px border around editable cell. Focus state uses ring-2 ring-[#7F1D1D].
tables.ocr_highlight: Low confidence fields get bg-[#FEF3C7] and border-l-2 border-[#D97706].

chat_inbox.layout: Left rail (300px wide) with scrollable conversation list. Right pane for active thread.
chat_inbox.bubbles: Outgoing (System/Quote): Soft Rose (#FEE2E2) with maroon text. Incoming (Customer): Stone 100 (#F5F5F4). No tails, soft rounded-lg corners.
chat_inbox.media: Images in chat have rounded-md, max-h-[300px], object-cover.

buttons.primary: bg-[#7F1D1D] text-white hover:bg-[#991B1B] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] text-[#1C1917] hover:bg-[#F5F5F4] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

forms.inputs: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#7F1D1D] focus:border-transparent text-sm

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Form. Right: Bleed image of electrical supplies with dark overlay.

inbox_ocr_view.layout: 3-column bento. Left: Chat rail. Middle: Chat thread. Right: OCR Pipeline & Smart Editor Sidebar (collapsible).

smart_enquiry_editor.interaction: Editable data table. 'New Product' badges in #FEE2E2. Autocomplete dropdowns for matching items. Real-time GST calculation row at bottom.

quotation_preview.layout: Centered modal or full-page. Preview of the image to be sent. Large 'Send via WhatsApp' CTA.

crm_customer_list.layout: Data-dense table, sticky header. Clicking a row opens Customer Profile Timeline (interleaved chat history and order history).

inventory_management.layout: Table with inline rate editing. Clicking rate history opens a modal with a timeline/chart.

automation_rules.layout: Grid of rule cards (Condition -> Action). Multi-step builder modal with logical branching.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, table rows) MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='ocr-sidebar-toggle').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Mahabir Electricals maroon (#7F1D1D) and white color palette.
Use Outfit for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
When building tables, use pure Tailwind/HTML logic combined with Shadcn table components. Avoid standard borders, favor clean bottom-borders for rows.
For the Inbox, ensure the chat interface feels native and distinct from WhatsApp. Use the specified bubble colors and soft rounded corners.
Ensure the Smart Enquiry Editor utilizes the specified Amber warning styles for low-confidence OCR extractions.
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
